verdict.rationale: Offline read, search, and write with sync on reconnect is a fair axis for an email client. Nothing in the evidence documents offline mode, local caching, or a sync queue. The note about storing emails in a Durable Object and R2 bucket describes server-side storage for speed, not client-side offline access.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect
